_about: Mechanical property classes for steel bolts, screws and studs (ISO 898-1), as tabulated in Shigley Table 8-11. Sp = minimum proof strength, Sut = minimum tensile strength, Sy = minimum yield strength (MPa). Se = fully corrected endurance strength for rolled threads (Shigley Table 8-17); null means it is estimated by the program (see bolted_joint.py). d_min/d_max give the size range (mm) each row applies to. rel_cost is an illustrative cost factor used only to rank options.
